what_happened: ast_grep_replace returned '[APPLIED] N replacements' for 8 import-extension rewrites in research/two-stage-backtest, but the files on disk were byte-identical afterwards (verified by grep + mtime).
root_cause: The ast_grep_replace tool in this environment reports APPLIED without persisting writes to the filesystem (dry-run behaviour leaking into the non-dryRun path, or writes sandboxed away). Search side works; write side did not.
what_i_did_wrong: I trusted the tool's APPLIED status without verifying, and only caught it because I grepped the files before compiling. Had I compiled straight away the failure would have surfaced as ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND and cost a debugging cycle.
fix: Re-did the same 6 edits with the edit tool and re-verified with grep before compiling.
actionable: After any bulk AST rewrite, grep the target pattern before moving on.
